name: Solipsism
body:
School enchantment [mind-affecting]; Level psychic 7, sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You manipulate the senses of the target creature so that it perceives itself to be the only real creature in all existence and everything around it is an illusion created by their mind or some nefarious outside force. If the target fails its save, it is convinced of the unreality of every situation it might encounter.

It takes no actions, not even purely mental actions, and instead watches the world around it with bemusement or frustration. The subject becomes effectively helpless and takes no steps to defend itself from any threat, since it considers any hostile action as unreal and any pain it may feel or damage suffered is fake. At the end of its turn, the target may make another saving throw to end the effect early.
